I checked the live GitHub queue against the current `main` branch. **All three open issues came from indii, are labeled Major, and are unassigned. None has a dedicated entry in Open Issues V4.** V4 became the active ledger on November 19, when V3 was archived. [GitHub issue queue](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/issues) · [Open Issues V4](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/blob/bb0542bedb7ba2523786f62a33a3505ffcebede7/.agent/test_ledger/OPEN_ISSUES_V4.md)

| Report | Existing coverage and follow-up |
|---|---|
| [#934 — Boardroom overclaims readiness](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/issues/934) | Recurrence after earlier fixes. V4 records closed #424, and a more recent fix for #917 already merged. The new ticket records four intercepted drafts across Generalist, Video, Social, and Marketing. Track the recurrence and verify what reaches the user. [V4 history](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/blob/bb0542bedb7ba2523786f62a33a3505ffcebede7/.agent/test_ledger/OPEN_ISSUES_V4.md#L2423) · [Prior Entire fix](https://entire.com/gh/indii-music-founder/-/trails/355/changes/indii-music-founder/355) |
| [#936 — Direct-mode upload and timeout failures](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/issues/936) | V4’s ISSUE-1654 covers a related 120-second timeout enforcement repair. This report still needs checks for all four symptoms: timed-out follow-ups, failed `batch_edit_images` reads, mismatched workspace IDs, and Visual Autorater corrections on non-image turns. [ISSUE-1654](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/blob/bb0542bedb7ba2523786f62a33a3505ffcebede7/.agent/test_ledger/OPEN_ISSUES_V4.md#L3461) |
| [#937 — PII redaction corrupts asset IDs](https://github.com/indii-music-founder/indii-music-founder/issues/937) | No matching ledger entry found. Track this as a new defect and verify that print asset and health-history IDs survive serialization while payment-card redaction still works. |

This was a read-only triage pass. The follow-up is to cross-link each report in V4, record an owner and acceptance checks, and carry each fix through verification before closing its GitHub issue.

So why don't you triage all of this and make sure that this whole system that you're very, very fond of and aware of at this point, well aware of at this point. Make sure it works as a triple star, whatever they call that stuff, you know, that thing. That's what we need to be
I’ll use the ATB workflow to reconcile all three reports in V4, reproduce the failures, and work through fixes and verification on main. I’ll keep the existing Boardroom work intact.
